description: How effects sharing a stack key combine on the same target.

items.description: Every effect counts. The default; most indie games use no keys at all.
Only the effect with the highest value counts (5E same-source effects; orc-2e bonus types).
Only the effect with the lowest value counts (orc-2e penalties of the same type).
Only one counts, and the player (through the app) chooses which; the engine reports the options as competing.
